exposure: Timing of head circumference measurement (birth vs. 3rd day of life)
outcome: Head circumference (HC) at birth and on the 3rd day of life
Change in HC between birth and 3rd day of life
cohort: The study included 1131 live births between February and May 2019 with a gestational age greater than 27 weeks.
finding: Serial head circumference measurements on the third day of life (DOL3) or before discharge are crucial for classifying congenital microcephaly, as HC significantly increased by a mean of 0.17 cm by DOL3, leading to 25 out of 32 initially microcephalic newborns no longer meeting the criteria.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was adjusted for in the analysis, but no specific association with head circumference increase was reported.
